set_all_non_lazy_fields: set all non-lazy fields in a TestAllTypes protobuf message to unique test values
set_all_extensions: set every extension field in a TestAllExtensions protobuf message to unique test values
expect_all_fields_set: test that all fields in a protobuf message have the expected values after SetAllFields
set_all_packed_fields: set all packed repeated fields in a TestPackedTypes protobuf message to unique test values
golden_file_data: read and return the binary contents of a protobuf golden test data file
